info.name: Palo Alto Networks ZTNA Connector API
info.description:
ZTNA Connector API for zero trust network access management. Provides programmatic control over ZTNA connectors, connector groups, protected applications, FQDN-based access rules, subnet-based access rules, and license information. Connectors are software agents deployed in private network environments that provide secure access paths for ZTNA-protected applications without requiring inbound firewall rules. Part of the Palo Alto Networks SASE platform.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support

Palo Alto Networks Schedule Connector Upgrade

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the connector to upgrade.

request.description: Schedules a software upgrade for a specific ZTNA connector. The upgrade can be scheduled for immediate execution or for a specified maintenance window. During the upgrade, the connector briefly disconnects; traffic is routed through other connectors in the same group if available.
